{"content":"Keep protected events on the summary route when the new editor is enabled. With calendar.item.editInTab=true and calendar.event.createEditDialog.enabled=true, Details sends read-only events and invitations through modifyEventWithDialog. openEventDialog selects the summary URL and clears args.inTab, but this later condition then opens the new create/edit dialog.","codeSuggestion":"","assessment":"Required change. This condition already exists, but the new Details route exposes it for protected events. The preference defaults to false, so the normal test run misses the failure.","rationale":"The condition checks mode === "modify" without preserving the earlier calendar-writability and isEditable decisions. This violates the patch's protected-event contract. The new dialog does not restore those permission checks.","recommendation":"change","validation":"The existing native test times out in test_detailsDoesNotEditReadOnlyEvent when run with --setpref=calendar.event.createEditDialog.enabled=true. The same test passes with the default preference. A dispatch experiment using the actual function confirms the incorrect route for both read-only events and invitations.","appliedSummary":"Updated:

- [calendar-item-editing.js](calendar/base/content/item-editing/calendar-item-editing.js): preserves the summary route for protected events.
- [browser_imipDetails.js](calendar/test/browser/invitations/browser_imipDetails.js): tests both preference values for read-only events and invitations.

Syntax, ESLint, formatting, whitespace, and 72 mocked routing checks passed. The diff follows the recorded patterns.

The evidence assessment remains incomplete. Native tests and `mach commlint` remain unrun because they write outside the allowed checkout. Changes remain unstaged and uncommitted.","changeSummary":"Preserve the summary route for protected events before selecting the new create/edit dialog. Extend the protected-event tests to cover both values of calendar.event.createEditDialog.enabled.","state":"handled","changeAccepted":false,"changeReverted":false,"changesAmended":true}
